title: Veterans Pension Benefit Income Statement — Amount Worksheet
content:
# Amount of the benefit income statement (Veterans Pension)

**Clause.** The benefit income statement on a Veterans Pension award is the veteran's own Social Security figure plus his federal civil service annuity plus the VA disability compensation counted for him, rounded to the cent. In the statement:

- **Social Security** is the annual figure on his most recent Social Security report, or nothing when no Social Security report is on file;
- **the annuity** is the annual figure on his most recent annuity report, or nothing when none is on file;
- **the monthly compensation** is the total of the monthly compensation payments issued to him since the pension effective date;
- **every retroactive compensation release** issued to him counts at its gross amount.

The date of the statement is the date it carries, the day the change began: the date the compensation award closed, or the date of the latest compensation payment when the award has not closed.

Each part is taken in dollars and cents, the release part rounded to the cent, and the four parts are added. "Most recent" report means the one most recently received. A figure that is taken as reported is used at a factor of 1, that is, unchanged; the year is 12 months.

## Worksheet layout

| Line | Source on the records | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| A | annual figure on the latest Social Security report | as shown, or 0 |
| B | annual figure on the latest annuity report | as shown, or 0 |
| C | monthly compensation payments issued since the pension effective date | total |
| D | retroactive compensation releases issued to the veteran | gross total |
| Statement | A plus B plus C plus D | rounded to the cent |

## Worked example (hypothetical veteran)

Latest Social Security report: 14400.00 a year. No annuity report on file. Monthly compensation issued since the pension effective date: four payments of 1200.00, total 4800.00. One retroactive release of 6000.00 gross.

Statement: 14400.00 plus 0 plus 4800.00 plus 6000.00, which is 25200.00.
